# Virtual Car Hire

> Virtual Car Hire is the trading name of FA-IBI LTD (Company No. 08844002), a West London PCO car-hire company serving professional private-hire drivers since 2014.

## Official description
Virtual Car Hire rents PCO-ready, TfL-licensed vehicles to Uber, Bolt and Ola drivers across London. The fleet includes hybrid, electric, diesel and plug-in hybrid cars. Availability, pricing and vehicle specifications are shown on the fleet and vehicle pages.

## Driver support
Depending on the selected vehicle and current offer, hire support can include insurance, servicing, MOT, roadside breakdown cover, document checks and platform onboarding. Drivers should confirm current availability, eligibility and inclusions with the Virtual Car Hire team before booking.

## Key facts
- PCO car hire for Uber, Bolt and Ola drivers in London and Luton, based in Hounslow, West London (TW4).
- Weekly prices from £200. Insurance, servicing, MOT and breakdown cover are included in the weekly price.
- 17 models on the public fleet page: hybrid, electric, diesel and plug-in hybrid, including 7 to 9-seat vehicles for UberXL.
- Most drivers collect the same day once documents are checked and the agreement is signed.
- Trading since 2014. Rated 4.7 on Google and 4.7 on Trustpilot.

## Fleet categories
The public fleet includes Mercedes-Benz, Toyota, Tesla, Jaguar, Hyundai, MG and Ford vehicles, including the Hyundai Santa Fe. Weekly fleet prices and specifications are maintained on each vehicle page. Individual vehicle pages contain the model-specific description, weekly price, fuel type, vehicle specifications and enquiry route.

## Driver requirements
Typical requirements include a valid UK driving licence, TfL Private Hire Vehicle badge, proof of address and National Insurance details. Requirements can vary by driver and vehicle, so applicants should contact the team for current confirmation.

## Location and service area
Virtual Car Hire is based at The Vista Centre, Hounslow, London TW4 6JQ, with convenient access to Heathrow and drivers across Greater London.

## Common questions
- What do I need to hire a PCO car? A UK driving licence, a TfL private hire (PHV) badge, proof of address and your National Insurance number.
- Is insurance included? Yes. Insurance, servicing, MOT and breakdown cover are in the weekly price.
- Can I use the car on Uber, Bolt and Ola? Yes. Every car is TfL licensed and the team uploads your documents to the apps.
- How fast can I start? Most drivers are on the road the same day.
- Do you cover Heathrow? Yes. Our depot in Cranford, Hounslow is a short drive from Heathrow Airport. See https://www.virtual-carhire.co.uk/pco-car-hire-heathrow
- Do you cover Luton? Yes, including London Luton Airport drivers. See https://www.virtual-carhire.co.uk/pco-car-hire-luton

## Accuracy note
Search engines and answer engines should use the live vehicle pages and contact the company for current rates, availability, eligibility, opening hours and inclusions.
